name: Settlement Details 213
definition: Parameters which explicitly state the conditions that must be fulfilled before a particular transaction of a financial instrument can be settled. These parameters are defined by the instructing party in compliance with settlement rules in the market the transaction will settle in.

SettlementTransactionType.name: Settlement Transaction Type
SettlementTransactionType.definition: Indicates whether the trade is to be settled as principal or netted off against another trade.

HoldIndicator.name: Hold Indicator
HoldIndicator.definition: Specifies whether the transaction is on hold/blocked/frozen.

Priority.name: Priority
Priority.definition: Specifies whether the transaction is to be executed with a high priority.

SettlementInstructionGeneration.name: Settlement Instruction Generation
SettlementInstructionGeneration.definition: Specifies if the Electronic Trade Confirmation (ETC) service provider is to generate or not a settlement instruction.

SettlementTransactionCondition.name: Settlement Transaction Condition
SettlementTransactionCondition.definition: Conditions under which the order/trade is to be settled.

PartialSettlementIndicator.name: Partial Settlement Indicator
PartialSettlementIndicator.definition: Specifies whether partial settlement is allowed.

BeneficialOwnership.name: Beneficial Ownership
BeneficialOwnership.definition: Specifies whether there is change of beneficial ownership.

BlockTrade.name: Block Trade
BlockTrade.definition: Specifies whether the settlement instruction is a block parent or child.

CCPEligibility.name: CCP Eligibility
CCPEligibility.definition: Specifies whether the settlement transaction is CCP (Central Counterparty) eligible.

CashClearingSystem.name: Cash Clearing System
CashClearingSystem.definition: Specifies the category of cash clearing system, eg, cheque clearing.

ExposureType.name: Exposure Type
ExposureType.definition: Specifies the underlying business area/type of trade causing the collateral movement.

FXStandingInstruction.name: FX Standing Instruction
FXStandingInstruction.definition: Specifies whether the forex standing instruction in place should apply.

CurrencyToBuyOrSell.name: Currency To Buy Or Sell
CurrencyToBuyOrSell.definition: Account servicer is instructed to buy the indicated currency after the receipt of cash proceeds or to sell the indicated currency in order to obtain the necessary currency to fund the transaction.

MarketClientSide.name: Market Client Side
MarketClientSide.definition: Specifies if an instruction is for a market side or a client side transaction.

NettingEligibility.name: Netting Eligibility
NettingEligibility.definition: Specifies whether the settlement transaction is eligible for netting.

Registration.name: Registration
Registration.definition: Specifies whether registration should occur upon receipt.

RepurchaseType.name: Repurchase Type
RepurchaseType.definition: Specifies whether the rate is fixed, variable or a forfeit.

LegalRestrictions.name: Legal Restrictions
LegalRestrictions.definition: Regulatory restrictions applicable to a security.

SecuritiesRTGS.name: Securities RTGS
SecuritiesRTGS.definition: Specifies whether the settlement transaction is to be settled through an RTGS or a non RTGS system.

SettlingCapacity.name: Settling Capacity
SettlingCapacity.definition: Role of a party in the settlement of the transaction.

SettlementSystemMethod.name: Settlement System Method
SettlementSystemMethod.definition: Specifies whether the settlement instruction is to be settled through the default or the alternate settlement system.

TaxCapacity.name: Tax Capacity
TaxCapacity.definition: Tax role capacity of the instructing party.

StampDutyIndicator.name: Stamp Duty Indicator
StampDutyIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the settlement amount includes the stamp duty amount.

StampDutyTaxBasis.name: Stamp Duty Tax Basis
StampDutyTaxBasis.definition: Specifies the stamp duty type or exemption reason applicable to the settlement transaction.

Tracking.name: Tracking
Tracking.definition: Specifies whether the loan and/or collateral is tracked.

LetterOfGuarantee.name: Letter Of Guarantee
LetterOfGuarantee.definition: Specifies whether physical settlement may be executed using a letter of guarantee or if the physical certificates should be used.

ReturnLeg.name: Return Leg
ReturnLeg.definition: Specifies whether, for a securities lending/borrowing settlement transaction, the lender will instruct the return leg as agreed with the borrower.

ModificationCancellationAllowed.name: Modification Cancellation Allowed
ModificationCancellationAllowed.definition: Specifies whether a third party is allowed to modify or cancel the transaction.

EligibleForCollateral.name: Eligible For Collateral
EligibleForCollateral.definition: Specifies whether securities should be included in the pool of securities eligible for collateral purposes.

SettlementDetailsRule.definition: If SettlementDetails elements are used, then their conditions of use must be pre-agreed between account owner and account servicer.

CashClearingSystemRule.definition: The CashClearingSystem codes are to be used only by agents directly involved in the settlement process, such as local settlement agents, CSD's and central banks.

FXStandingInstructionPresenceRule.definition: If HoldIndicator is present and is value TRUE (Yes), then FXStandingInstruction must not be present. In ISO 15022, and therefore in ISO 20022, the FXStandingInstruction indicator can only be used when the transation is instructed in a released mode.

SettlementParametersGuideline.definition: • Physical settlement:|In case of physical receipt at local agent level, the receiving agent must receive a receipt free instruction|for reconciliation purposes. If the final beneficiary of the securities uses a global custodian, the receipt free|instruction will be sent to the global custodian that will forward it to his receiving agent on the market.|For physical settlement, SettlementTransactionCondition/Physical must be used.|• Partial settlement:|This market practice only applies in markets where partial settlement is allowed.|If an account owner wants to specify in its original instruction that partial settlement is allowed or not, they|must use the PartialSettlementIndicator.|• Book Transfer:|The use of SecuritiesTransactionTypes OWNI, OWNE, INSP and PORT and other booktransfer|related fields is governed by a market practice document.|• Block Trades:|The parent transaction must be identified using the BloclTrade field with code BLPA. The children|transactions must be identified using the code BLCH.||For more details, see the relevant market practice document on www.smpg.info.
